title: Source
description: A primary or secondary document, recording, or artefact from which evidence is extracted. Sources have documented provenance, a type classification, and a quality tier.

id.description: Stable entity identifier in format boe:source:<ulid>. Constant across versions.

title.description: Official title of the source document, or a descriptive title if no official one exists.

description.description: Brief description of what this source is and why it is relevant.

date.description: Date the source was created or published.

url.description: URL where the source can be accessed. A URL locates a source; it does NOT identify its content — URLs rot and their contents change. Use 'artifacts' to fix exact bytes.

archive_url.description: Persistent archived copy URL (web.archive.org, archive.ph, etc.).

artifacts.description: Exact byte representations of this source that have been obtained and verified. Every source used to support an assessment above confidence level 2 should have at least one artifact with a digest. This is what makes 'the source said X' checkable against silent content replacement.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest (lowercase hex) of the exact bytes of this artifact.

byte_length.description: Size of the artifact in bytes.

retrieved_at.description: When these exact bytes were retrieved.

retrieved_from.description: The URL these bytes were retrieved from.

storage_location.description: Where the artifact bytes are preserved (archive URL, institutional repository, content-addressed store). Large artifacts do not belong in Git history.

rights.description: Rights/licence status of this artifact and whether redistribution is permitted. Third-party documents are NOT covered by the repository licence.

notes.description: Verification notes (e.g., checksum match against an official published digest).

location.description: Physical or institutional location (e.g., 'National Archives, RG 272, Box 14').

quality_tier.description: Source quality tier: A=verified_primary, B=probable_primary, C=credible_secondary, D=unverified, E=disputed.

quality_tier_rationale.description: Explanation of why this quality tier was assigned.

language.description: Language of the source (ISO 639-1 code, e.g., 'en', 'fr').

classification_at_time.description: Classification level at the time of creation (e.g., 'TOP SECRET', 'CONFIDENTIAL', 'UNCLASSIFIED').

current_classification.description: Current classification level, if declassified or changed.
